title: Canonical Reconstruction Model v2 (P2.5)
description: Backend-independent sparse reconstruction result (D-CRM-01…D-CRM-20). Every reconstruction backend (COLMAP, SLAM, hybrid, AI priors) produces this document through its adapter. The document carries spatial content, provenance, and optional uncertainty. Lifecycle state (reconstructing/succeeded/failed/superseded) belongs to the DB ReconstructionRow, NOT this document — this document represents a finalized reconstruction result.

schema_version.description: Document schema version. Transitions from 1 (provisional COLMAP-shaped) to 2 (canonical backend-independent) per D-CRM-10.

reconstruction_id.description: Instance-scoped UUIDv4 identity (D-CRM-07). A reconstruction is an execution result, not a content-derived fact.

session_ids.description: Capture sessions that contributed images to this reconstruction (D-CRM-12). Supports multi-session SLAM and future map-merging.

coordinate_frame.description: Reconstruction-local coordinate frame name, assigned by the adapter, prefixed with 'reconstruction_' (D-CRM-06). NOT 'project_world' unless alignment has been performed.

status.description: Document-level status (D-CRM-19). For a finalized CAS payload this should be 'succeeded'. Lifecycle transitions are managed by the DB ReconstructionRow.

created_at_ns.description: Creation timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch.

cameras.description: Camera models used in this reconstruction (D-CRM-04, D-CRM-05).

images.description: ALL input images, including detected=false for unregistered ones (D-CRM-20). Consumers filter by detected=true when they only want registered images.

points3D.description: Reconstructed 3D points (D-CRM-08). Each point carries its observation track.

uncertainty.description: Optional reconstruction-level uncertainty (D-CRM-08). Per-point uncertainty may also be present in points3D[].

ReconPose.description: SE(3) rigid-body transform: T_reconstruction_camera (D-CRM-01). Maps points from camera frame to the reconstruction's local frame. Quaternion order: (x, y, z, w) scalar-last per ADR-007 (D-CRM-02).

rotation_xyzw.description: Unit quaternion in (x, y, z, w) scalar-last order (D-CRM-02).

ReconCamera.description: Camera intrinsics and distortion (D-CRM-04, D-CRM-05). Backend-local camera_id is scoped to this Reconstruction document (D-CRM-03).

camera_id.description: Backend-local camera identifier, scoped to this Reconstruction (D-CRM-03).

distortion_model.description: Distortion model (D-CRM-04). Separate from projection model.

calibration_ref.description: Optional reference to a CalibrationArtifact (D-CRM-05). For provenance only; does not imply intrinsics are identical.

ReconImage.description: One input image and its estimated pose (D-CRM-20). All input images are included, with detected=false for unregistered ones.

image_id.description: Backend-local image identifier, scoped to this Reconstruction (D-CRM-03).

frame_id.description: Optional UUID referencing a Frame in the import model. When present, bridges reconstruction images to the scene graph via frame_id → FeatureSet → FeatureArtifact. When absent, downstream resolution is required to establish the linkage.

detected.description: Whether this image was successfully registered in the reconstruction (D-CRM-20). false for images that were input but not localized.

point3d_id.description: Backend-local 3D point identifier, scoped to this Reconstruction (D-CRM-03).

xyz.description: 3D position in the reconstruction coordinate frame (meters).

color.description: RGB color [r, g, b], each channel 0–255.

error.description: Mean reprojection error in pixels. Always present (D-CRM-08).

track.description: Observation history of this point (D-CRM-16). Synthesized track — NOT a separate entity.

TrackElement.description: One observation of a 3D point from a 2D keypoint (D-CRM-09, D-CRM-16).

point2d_idx.description: Index into the FeatureArtifact.keypoints[] array for this image (D-CRM-09, D-CRM-18).

ReconObservation.description: Atomic 2D→3D association (D-CRM-09, D-CRM-18). Carries only the link; 2D coordinates live in the FeatureArtifact referenced via frame_id → FeatureSet chain.

ReconstructionProvenance.description: Full execution lineage (D-CRM-11). Carries backend identity, configuration, inputs, timing, and arbitrary backend-specific metadata.

configuration_hash.description: SHA-256 of the effective reconstruction configuration.

input_artifact_hashes.description: CAS hashes of input artifacts consumed by this reconstruction.

backend_specific_json.description: Arbitrary backend metadata as a JSON string (D-CRM-11). Prevents backend-specific fields from polluting the canonical model.

ReconUncertainty.description: Optional uncertainty block (D-CRM-08). Per-point or reconstruction-level.

covariance_xyz.description: 3×3 symmetric covariance matrix, flattened row-major (6 unique values).

source_count.description: Number of images observing this point (or contributing to the reconstruction-level estimate).
